decisions.why: examples are GI endoscopic resection/EMR accessories (Isnare System Lariat Snare, Ascendo Submucosal Lifting Agent, EUS biopsy device) - these are GI snare/resection-type products, not general endoscopy capital equipment
biological/chemical indicators, indicator tape, challenge packs and incubators are sterile processing (CSSD) monitoring consumables used to validate central decontamination cycles
examples (Endo Leak Tester, Endoscope Reprocessing Sinks, Endoscope Inspection Station, Automated Endoscope Reprocessors) are specifically endoscope decontamination equipment
washer racks and ultrasonic cleaning indicators are instrument washing/decontamination equipment for central sterile processing
point-of-use processing gel, cleaning chemistries, drying agent and descalers/lubricants are instrument cleaning chemistry used in central decontamination
instrument identification/tracking, instrument protection and a video borescope are accessories used within the sterile processing department
low temperature sterilization systems and sterilization trays are central decontamination sterilizer equipment
Amsco steam sterilizers and floor loaders are central decontamination sterilizer equipment
warming cabinets for blankets/fluids/supplies are patient warming & temperature management equipment
Electro Lube and Cautery Tip Cleaner are electrosurgery consumables used to maintain diathermy/cautery instruments
Onsite/Offsite CSSD Services are a decontamination service offering, matching Service & validation
manifold/instrument washer racks are central decontamination washing accessories
